title: Relative exponentials convert cartesian transport to cocartesian precomposition
statement:
Let $S$ and $B$ be small quasicategories and let $p:B\to S$ be a cartesian fibration [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $\mathscr A$ be a quasicategory in a containing universe [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Define $q:Q\to S$ by declaring an $n$-simplex of $Q$ to be a pair
$$\sigma:\Delta^n\to S,\qquad h:\Delta^n\times_S B\to\mathscr A.$$
Its operators are pullback along maps of standard simplices and restriction of $h$. Equivalently, for every simplicial set $K\to S$ there is a natural bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{/S}(K,Q)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}}(K\times_S B,\mathscr A).$$
Then $Q$ is a quasicategory, $q$ is a cocartesian fibration, and its fibre over $s$ is $\operatorname{Fun}(B_s,\mathscr A)$. An edge $(\sigma,h)$ of $Q$ is $q$-cocartesian exactly when $h$ carries every cartesian edge of $\Delta^1\times_S B\to\Delta^1$ to an equivalence in $\mathscr A$.

source.place: Corollary 3.2.2.13, printed p. 187 (PDF p. 205), specialized to Y = S × A; its cocartesian edges are exactly those whose A-component is an equivalence. Compare the opposite-category dual of Kerodon Corollary 5.3.6.9 (Tag 0472). The degreewise fibre formula is the displayed relative Hom formula at a constant vertex. WANTED: archived HTT and Kerodon.
